children: Overview
Canada NMR spectrometer maker's Q3 revenue rose 14% yr/yr to C$10.57 mln
Net income reached C$0.4 mln, reversing a loss from prior year
Improved results driven by higher product sales and better gross margins
Outlook
Company says focus remains on operational improvement and pursuing revenue growth opportunities
Company continues to invest in expanding sales pipeline and international distributor network
Result Drivers
PRODUCT SALES GROWTH - Higher benchtop NMR sales drove increased product revenue in Q3
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Increased manufacturing productivity and better cost management lifted gross margins in both operating segments
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCIES - Changes to logistics, overtime management, and service execution improved Security Services margins
